build_torchdim_cpp_extension: build the torchdim C++ extension module with functorch sources included
build_torchdim_without_functorch: build the torchdim extension using a pre-installed functorch library instead of bundling sources
generate_compile_commands_json: generate a compile_commands.json file from the ninja build database for tooling support
configure_cpp_extension_compile_args: configure the CppExtension with extra compile flags to suppress write-strings and sign-compare warnings
setup_torchdim_package: setup the torchdim package with version 1.0 and first class dimensions description
